query: Design a media player UI that has to work on a phone, a laptop, and a TV.
expected_behavior: Adapts to touch on phone, pointer and keyboard on laptop, and explicit remote focus navigation on TV
Keeps essential actions available without hover and makes focus order and current selection clear
Chooses fluid sizing or breakpoints based on content fit and the supported platforms, without requiring a named CSS technique
Addresses TV viewing distance, focus visibility, and safe margins where applicable
Applies WCAG 2.2 AA target-size criteria within scope and names any additional platform recommendation with its units and context
